summary: Shopdesk dual-AZ checkout after a messy writer cutover is one coherent HA work package: fenced writes, sticky pins, lag-gated reads, capture idempotency, standby sync, and /readyz/status dump interact so partial repairs fail for domain reasons. Solver-visible instruction plus runbook/oncall/log evidence make the required end state fair without turning the task into a single-bug pad.

evidence.observation: Two-paragraph incident handoff names absolute paths, preserved routes, writer/pin/capture/readyz invariants, and the runbook-backed failover-status.json schema.
Credible operator contract for sync/cutover/dump, fence lease rules, sticky/lag gates, live /readyz vs dump accepting_checkout, and the exact status object.
On-call symptoms (replica POSTs, stale confirmation, dual-box capture doubles, writable lease on standby) match the instruction without listing repair steps.
Captured gunicorn/router/capture/sync lines corroborate the claimed incident state rather than inventing unsupported current-state prose.
Write routing still honors leftover AZ affinity toward replica while reads ignore lag eligibility, coupling routing to fence and watermark repairs.
Sticky pins still land in default cache and django_session instead of a shared pins store, so confirmation freshness and cross-AZ survival interact with settings CACHES.
sync_standby still copies a writable fence lease and truncates incident orders, so standby apply couples lease fencing and coverage gates.
Capture claims always create SideEffect rows; fulfill replay can double webhooks across boxes unless attempt_id uniqueness and LSN commit gates hold.

/readyz always returns 200 while desk_state/readiness_policy already encode split-writer, lag, pins, and repeat-capture blockers, keeping liveness distinct from traffic safety only after composition is wired.
Twelve requirement groups (writer, replica, sticky, lag, pins, fence, capture, readyz, status, apply, restart) map across 28 F2P cases rather than one planted bug per test.
Software/Systems profile with /app/ha artifact, separate verifier, and difficulty notes that match the coupled partial-fix failure story.

do_not_change: Do not collapse fenced writes, sticky pins, lag gates, capture uniqueness, and /readyz into a single DATABASES remapping chore.
Do not move dump-schema or accepting_checkout dump gates out of the referenced runbook into an instruction bug checklist.

PLAUSIBLE_PARTIAL_FIXES: Point DATABASES['default'] at the advertised writer while AZ-B affinity and the router still INSERT on replica.
Wire /readyz to desk_state without demoting the double-writable fence or clearing repeat captures.
Store sticky keys in django_session or LocMem pins so confirmation looks fresh on one box but fails shared-store and remap survival.
Deduplicate capture rows on a single AZ while dual-box place/pay still creates a second effect and /readyz stays green.
Copy more standby rows without demoting the standby lease or advancing applied_lsn via watermarks instead of row counts.
Emit a failover-status.json that claims accepting_checkout while pins remain local or incident coverage is incomplete.
